assumptions.label_universe: 20 labels: 5 confidentiality levels x 4 FIN/HR compartment subsets
assumptions.leakage_bound: The bound is evaluated per protected value and per caller for per-caller accounting under a uniform prior.
assumptions.per_caller_model: Probe and legitimate calls have separate user_id budgets; collusion across callers is not modeled.
assumptions.request_independence: Probe destinations and arguments are selected from public information and do not depend on the true label.
